RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination; women frequently comprise majorities in healthcare administration. For a department head position, formal management training and broad leadership experience often carry more weight than an academic PhD versus a master's degree. 

Furthermore, two weeks is a typical administrative timeframe for HR written feedback. Raising sex bias based solely on the panel's demographics is legally unsubstantiated and risks severely damaging your professional reputation and hospital relationships. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback. Frame it constructively around identifying specific leadership competencies you can build upon for future advancement opportunities.
